pre-commit.name: preservation-guard
pre-commit.command: bash infrastructure/automation/preservation.sh verify-additive baseline/pre-planning-HEAD HEAD || echo 'PRESERVATION CHECK FAILED - see infrastructure/automation/preservation.sh' >&2

pre-push.name: preservation-guard
pre-push.command: bash infrastructure/automation/preservation.sh verify-additive baseline/pre-planning-HEAD HEAD || echo 'PRESERVATION CHECK FAILED - blocking push' >&2; exit 1
